title: Social force model published
description: Helbing and Molnar's pedestrian model in Physical Review E becomes the basis of agent-based crowd simulation.

title: Alpenexpress VR-Ride unveiled at Europa-Park
description: First VR coaster: headsets synced to a 1984 mine train; VR Coaster GmbH founded the same year.

title: The Void opens Star Wars: Secrets of the Empire
description: Free-walk hyper-reality VR with physical sets launches at Disney Springs; the company closes in 2020.

title: Stuntronics revealed
description: Disney shows a humanoid stunt-double robot that flips untethered and lands on its mark, following Stickman in May.

title: Walt Disney World tests facial recognition entry
description: Opt-in trial at Magic Kingdom links faces to random numbers with 30-day deletion; later withdrawn after feedback.

title: Disney Genie announced
description: Free planner that builds and keeps updating itineraries from guest preferences; paid Genie+ launches alongside.

title: BD-X droids roam Galaxy's Edge daily
description: RL-trained bipedal droids become a daily offering at Disneyland through June 2, 2024.

title: Robotic Olaf debuts at Disneyland Paris
description: A free-walking Olaf trained with reinforcement learning opens in World of Frozen.

title: Galactica reopens with VR headsets
description: Alton Towers' flying coaster Air returns with a Gear VR headset at every seat.

title: Galactica's VR headsets removed
description: After a 2018 cut-back to three rows, the park removes VR, citing guest feedback.
